### Usage Examples

#### Basic Plugin Testing
```python
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_plugin_functionality(plugin_harness, mock_gpio):
    """Test plugin with hardware mocking."""
    plugin = await plugin_harness.load_plugin(
        MyPluginClass,
        "test_plugin",
        {"GPIO": 18, "Inverted": "No"}
    )
    
    await plugin.on()
    assert mock_gpio.input(18) == mock_gpio.HIGH
```

#### I2C Device Testing
```python
def test_i2c_communication(mock_i2c, mock_7seg_display):
    """Test I2C device interactions."""
    # Simulate device communication
    mock_i2c.write_byte(0x70, 0xFF)
    mock_7seg_display.print("12.3")
    
    assert mock_7seg_display.get_display_content() == "12.3"
```

#### Configuration Testing
```python
def test_plugin_config():
    """Test plugin configuration generation."""
    config = GPIOActorConfigFactory(
        id="test_actor",
        props={"GPIO": 18, "Inverted": "Yes"}
    )
    
    assert config.props["GPIO"] == 18
    assert config.props["Inverted"] == "Yes"
```
